title: Fundamental Limits of Perfect Concept Erasure
benchmark_measurement: The ability to erase the concept of religion from GPT-4 text embeddings to ensure it does not affect downstream toxicity classification scores, as a measure of fairness.
findings: The proposed method, Perfect Erasure Function (PEF), effectively erases religion information from GPT-4 text embeddings. This leads to significantly improved fairness (measured by generalized demographic parity) in a downstream toxicity classification task, while having a minimal negative impact on the model's performance (utility).
references: Jigsaw unintended bias in toxicity classification. 2019.
